title: Obi-Wan’s Daring Maneuver
front_description: In the Slave I cockpit, Jango and Boba Fett witness a huge explosion as Obi-Wan's ship appears to have been destroyed. "We won't see him again!" an elated Jango tells his wickedly amused offspring. Their own craft emerges from the treacherous belt of space rocks and heads down toward the planet Geonosis. But unknown to the Fetts, Obi-Wan has safely hidden his ship on the underside of one of the pitted asteroids.
back_description: A concept model of Obi-Wan Kenobi's Jedi Starfighter built by John Duncan.
